6. The final environmental impact statement was sent to the Council on Environmental Quality and made available to the public on or about March 14, 1977.
7. Several of the letters of comment contained information about the project, responses to the application filed by Duke Power Company, and statements of position regarding the proposed Bad Creek Project. Staff has attempted to insure that all aspects of the environmental impact that would be created by the proposed project are addressed in the final statement. Insofar as possible and appropriate, response has been made to comments in letters received, except in those cases where it was the opinion of Staff that such comments represented a statement of position and thereby required no response in the final environmental impact statement.
